channel.title: Donald the Lame Duck
channel.description: Original political satire from the royal pond.

item.title: THE SAFETY TEST HAS ONE QUESTION.
item.description: Donald tests a clockwork duck by asking who is president, then awards himself the certificate. Inspired by his September 14 claim that presidential judgment supplies AI guardrails; he also cited existing regulatory and criminal powers. The test and toy are invented. Original duck-world political satire. All dialogue, props and actions are invented; receipts establish the public remarks. Sources: Reuters / MarketScreener: https://www.marketscreener.com/news/trump-says-there-is-a-sick-conspiracy-against-ai-data-centers-ce785bdcdc81ff24 AP: https://apnews.com/article/b85df16775ff7e9611a456b061a0e4b9

item.title: THE LABEL FITS.
item.description: Donald finds a smaller name for an enormous problem. Only the label fits in the box. Inspired by his September 4 description of the Iran conflict; the block and box are invented visual allegory. Original duck-world political satire. Dialogue and props are invented; source receipts establish the real remarks. Sources: American Presidency Project: https://www.presidency.ucsb.edu/documents/pool-reports-september-4-2026 SBS / AFP: https://www.sbs.com.au/news/article/trump-says-iran-war-small-potatoes-as-conflict-grinds-on/2zwuji5wj
